name: dftracer_skills
description: The dftracer-agents knowledge surface for any harness: skill_list / skill_search / skill_load (whole skill, one '## ' section, or a sibling file such as a lessons log, with related [[skills]]), agents_sync / permissions_sync / hooks_sync (re-render harness copies from the canonical YAML templates, permissions.yaml and hooks.py), memory_list / memory_recall / memory_read (git-tracked project memory), and a validator for a skill or memory file (dftracer_skills_check). Load at session start, before acting on anything a skill may cover, after editing an agent template, permissions.yaml or hooks.py, or on 'No .agents/skills directory found', 'No section matching', 'not_found', or agents_sync conflicts.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents dftracer/skills_service.py (all tools except memory_write, whose name the store's knowledge capability already provides) and the skills-first / agents_sync rules of skill dftracer-lessons and agent dftracer-report
